_comment: Translator notes per key. tools/i18n-build.mjs copies them into the 'description' field of every _locales/*/messages.json. Keys marked maxLength are enforced by test/i18n.test.js.

locales.en: English (default locale; every other file must have exactly the same keys)
locales.es: Spanish (neutral; used for Spain and Latin America)
locales.pt_PT: Portuguese, Portugal (alias of pt_BR with local adaptations; Chrome does not fall back from pt_PT to pt_BR)

appName.note: Store name. Must start with the brand 'Colonist Card Tracker'; after a dash, a short local phrase meaning 'Catan card counter'. Web Store shows about 35 characters in search results and recommends 45 at most.

appDesc.note: Short description shown by Chrome and as the Web Store summary. HARD LIMIT 132 characters. Keep 'Catan', 'card counter' and 'colonist.io' near the start.

rateAsk.note: Footer link shown after the third finished game, once: invitation to rate the extension in the Web Store. Friendly, no pressure, no reward.

rateDismiss.note: Tooltip of the small × next to rateAsk: dismisses the invitation for good.

title.note: Panel title, next to a card emoji. Keep short.

waiting.note: Status shown while no game is loaded.

waitingHint.note: Hint under the waiting status. F5 is the reload key.

spectator.note: Status chip when the user is watching, not playing. Lowercase if the language allows.

turn.note: Prefix before the turn number, e.g. 'turn 12'.

bank.note: Row label for the bank's cards. Use the same word colonist.io uses in this language.

you.note: Small tag after the user's own name: '(you)'.

bot.note: Tooltip on the robot icon next to computer players.

dice.note: Section title for the dice histogram.

steals.note: Footer: number of steals whose card was not visible, e.g. '3 hidden steals'.

scenarios.note: Footer: number of possible worlds being tracked, e.g. '120 scenarios'.

approx.note: Footer suffix in parentheses when the scenario count was capped.

synced.note: Tooltip on the green check next to a player's total.

desync.note: Tooltip on the red exclamation mark next to a player's total.

total.note: Column header for the total. The sigma symbol is fine in every language; change only if it reads badly.

totalTitle.note: Tooltip of the total column header.

contradictions.note: Tooltip of the warning triangle in the footer.

knights.note: Tooltip fragment after a number: '2 knights played'.

expVP.note: Tooltip fragment before a number: 'expected VP 0.4'. VP = victory points; use the local abbreviation if one exists.

unknownCol.note: Tooltip of the '?' column (cards of unknown type).

modeRange.note: Tooltip of the % button when the panel shows expected values (click switches to range mode).

modeExpected.note: Tooltip of the % button when the panel shows ranges (click switches to expected values).

close.note: Tooltip of the × button. Keep the key combination Alt+Shift+C literally.

rec.note: Blinking recording indicator, like on a camera. Keep 'REC' unless the language has a common alternative.

consentTitle.note: Heading of the consent card shown before the counter works.

consentText.note: LEGAL TEXT. Translate faithfully, do not shorten: it says the extension is free, that it stores game history (moves, trades and chat) anonymously, that names are replaced by codes before anything leaves the browser, that data is collected exclusively for research on decision-making and negotiation in the game, and that accepting is required to use the counter.

consentYes.note: Primary button of the consent card.

consentNo.note: Secondary button of the consent card.

consentMore.note: Link that opens the options page.

consentDeclined.note: Text shown instead of consentText after the user declined.

resLumber.note: Resource tooltip. Use the exact word colonist.io shows in this language for the wood resource.

resCloth.note: Cities & Knights commodity, as in colonist.io.

resCoin.note: Cities & Knights commodity, as in colonist.io.

resPaper.note: Cities & Knights commodity, as in colonist.io.

researchTitle.note: Options page: heading of the consent section.

researchText.note: LEGAL TEXT, options page. Longer version of consentText; translate faithfully and completely.

installId.note: Label before the random installation identifier.

privacy.note: Link text to the privacy policy.

serverTitle.note: Options page: heading of the server section (advanced users).

endpoint.note: Label of the server URL field.

token.note: Label of the optional token field.

saved.note: Confirmation shown for two seconds after saving.

gamesTitle.note: Options page: heading of the recorded games table.

deleteAllConfirm.note: Browser confirm() dialog before deleting local data.

colFrames.note: Table column header: number of network messages recorded.

empty.note: Shown when the table is empty.

partial.note: Small tag after a game id when the recording did not capture the whole game.

status_pending.note: Row status: waiting to be uploaded.

status_failed.note: Row status: upload failed after retries.

status_local.note: Row status: kept locally because no server is configured.

devKnightName.note: Development card name (tooltip and revealed-cards list). Use colonist.io's term.

devVPName.note: Development card name: victory point card.

devYearOfPlentyName.note: Development card name. Colonist calls it 'Invento' in Spanish, 'Erfindung' in German.

devInHand.note: Suffix after a number in the development-cards section: '2 in hand'.

devPlayed.note: Label before the icons of the cards a player has played.

devNone.note: Shown in the development-cards section when nobody has played a card yet.

devDeck.note: Suffix after a number: '19 in the deck' (development cards left to buy).

moreStats.note: Title of the collapsible section with the dice histogram and tracker statistics.

round.note: Status prefix before the round number (one round = every player has taken a turn), e.g. 'round 12'.
